title: Connect Full Toeplitz programs to rounded native calls (no new κ)
body:
Close the numerical service boundary left in #4253's DENSE-PROOF.md for actual forward/stored-inverse Full programs. Power-of-two rescaling keeps every native entrance in the unit disk; a source-derived whole-field error allocation preserves the strict target and O(F0+t+log N+log lambda+log Q+log R) widths. Original pages, routing and host rounding sites remain.

The concrete backend calls #5485's unchanged rounded C kernel, with exact H/2 phases/normalization and charged local packing. This adds an actual producer-consumer connection beyond #4178's exact-H tensor scan. The older Schur questions are already covered by #4205 and are not new claims.

Base and all source pins: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a; complete Git/SHA256 closure in SOURCES.json.

Reproduce (CPython 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/full-native-domain-adapter
```
Expected: PASS_FULL_NATIVE_DOMAIN_ADAPTER twice and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: normal/optimized registered replays; 17 trajectories, 8,154 native calls, 32,616 butterflies, 1,836 nonzero internal roundings. Separate exact matrix elimination checks both endpoints. Thirteen controls reject domain, phase, normalization, field-tolerance, grid, bit, overflow and source/allocation faults. Lead independently reviewed the proof/source budgets and reran both modes. Committed bytes/modes and complete remote tree match the tested package.

No new κ. This is a source-relative numerical theorem with a direct backend, not an accelerated fixed-tape supplier. Global tensor/stock/layout integration, physical coefficient delivery and full analytic recovery remain open; all five framework assumptions remain. No hosted CI, human/kernel acceptance or full-history preflight claimed.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml (#4205/#4253/#4178), JoyboyBrian (#5485), Vlado Vojdanovski (#1673), Chafik Boukhalfa (#628) and retained lineage. Apache-2.0.
